visualCharacteristics.purpose: horizontal strip: a title on the left and a row of icon + eyebrow + link items

contentPattern.structure: one row; first cell is the strip title (heading or text), each further cell an item: icon, eyebrow text, link title, optional body text. with-body-text: items carry a heading and paragraph

usage: Explore-more / get-started link strips, PDF download strips
reuseGuidance: Use for a titled strip of icon links. Not for full feature columns (columns-icon-features).
